summary: Field cleanup helper: reads the pointer at this+0x1EC (this[123]); if non-null, passes it to FreeWrapper_7bcf, stores the wrapper's return value as the result, and clears the field to 0. Returns the loaded pointer when the field was null (no free performed), otherwise the FreeWrapper_7bcf return value. Called from SceneGraph (0x0054A770) during cleanup.

local_names.this: object holding the resource pointer being freed
local_names.result: field value or FreeWrapper_7bcf return value

operations.description: Load result = the pointer stored at this+0x1EC (this[123]).
Guard: if the loaded pointer is non-null, free and clear; otherwise skip and return the null value.
Call FreeWrapper_7bcf(this[123]) to free the resource pointer at this+0x1EC.
Store the FreeWrapper_7bcf return value as result.
Clear the field to 0 after freeing: this[123] = 0.
Return result (the FreeWrapper_7bcf return value, or the original null field value when no free occurred).

unresolved: The meaning of the FreeWrapper_7bcf return value is unknown; the function passes it through to its own caller.
